CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSParseEuroCurrency

Reads a euro amount written in the conventions of the current locale and returns it as a number. Thousands separators and spaces are skipped; parentheses make the amount negative.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSParseEuroCurrency(string)

Parameters

string
The amount to convert, for example "1,234.50".

Returns

The amount as a number.

Usage

If the string is not a currency amount, the function throws an error. KoldFusion understands the English (US) conventions only (see SetLocale) and does not recognize the "EUR" code that LSEuroCurrencyFormat puts in front of an amount; remove it first, for example with Replace.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Amounts = "1,234.50|(99.95)|2002">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>LSParseEuroCurrency</TH><TH>Formatted</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="A" LIST="#Amounts#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#A#</TD><TD>#LSParseEuroCurrency(A)#</TD><TD>#LSEuroCurrencyFormat(LSParseEuroCurrency(A))#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also
